name: taste-skill
title: design-taste-frontend
description: Builds professional company and product websites with an anti-slop finish gate: plain copy in its own voice, one system, one section per screen, real photographs, dealt moments and quiet micro-interactions, enforced by a checker that screenshots the page in a real browser. Runtime note: needs Node 22+ and Chrome (it launches its own headless Chrome with its own profile, never the user's browser) and fetches icons from jsdelivr and CC/public-domain photos from Wikimedia Commons.
why: Where Impeccable directs, Taste finishes: its screenshot-and-judge gate makes 'looks done' a measured claim instead of a vibe, and its photo/icon pipeline solves the stand-in asset problem honestly.
